A forensic investigation is underway to determine the extent of the breach and its implications.

Prosecutors said the company used customers’ insurance information to bill government-backed healthcare programmes for COVID-19 testing services that were never provided. Seyhun admitted helping submit fraudulent claims and agreed to forfeit $4.31 million.

The men allegedly assaulted the girl at knife point in various locations within the park. After the attacks, they threatened her and her friend to remain silent about the incident.

title: 43,674 children’s toys recalled over button battery ingestion risk
content: Attention parents: approximately 43,674 light-up children's toys have been recalled due to dangerous battery compartments that children can easily access. This recall affects light-up glasses, crown headbands, sparkle headbands, and light-up ties sold from September 2016 to May 2026. Please ensure your children stop using these items and contact ABC Trading to obtain a refund. Dispose of these toys following local hazardous waste protocols.

title: California crews uncover possible 45-million-year-old ‘thunder beast’ fossils
content: Fossilised bones from a large hoofed mammal were uncovered during an excavation project in Oceanside, California. Paleontologists are studying the remains, which may belong to a thunder beast or a swamp rhino. The discovery took place approximately 12 feet below the surface in the Santiago Formation's sedimentary rock. Researchers are working to determine the exact identity of the fossils found during construction.

title: Zuckerberg’s $300m superyacht docks in Japan, gets neighbour who once wanted Meta out

Their close proximity underscores an ongoing legal dispute as Maezawa pursues Meta for the misuse of his name in deceptive investment advertising. Even without plans to meet, their vessels symbolize the intense rivalry. After a summer in Alaska, Launchpad is set to chart its course towards Singapore, making this encounter noteworthy.

title: UP twins face Aadhaar trouble after fingerprints and retina scans match

With their biometric data causing confusion due to being identical, their applications were stalled for months. Seeking help, the family turned to the district magistrate, and after tireless efforts, the administration coordinated with the relevant bodies to finally resolve the problem.

title: Shaili Singh: Anju Bobby George’s protege eyes a leap of faith at Asian Games
content: India's 22-year-old Indian long jumper Shaili Singh, overcame injuries and humble beginnings to emerge as one of India’s medal hopes at the 2026 Asian Games. Inspired by the legendary Anju Bobby George, Shaili’s journey is marked by resilience, visualisation, and a deep love for her sport, as she seeks to fulfill her potential on the continental stage.

title: Anthony Joshua opens up on toughest nine months ahead of Tyson Fury fight

After surviving a tragic car crash in Nigeria, Joshua is now focused on his upcoming match. He returned to the ring in July after tackling personal challenges and achieved a victory over Kristian Prenga. The highly anticipated bout with Fury marks a significant chapter in Joshua's career.

title: Zinedine Zidane bans haircuts at France camp, blocks hairdressers from Clairefontaine

He has also restricted media coverage, ending the tradition of players showcasing their outfits upon arrival. The new rules aim to create a more disciplined environment focused solely on football preparations. Zidane replaced Didier Deschamps, who had been in charge for 14 years. The changes signal the beginning of Zidane's era with Les Bleus.

title: Got keys to your home after years of delay? You may still claim interest for lost time
content: In India, homebuyers can seek interest compensation for delays in property possession from developers. Recent judicial decisions confirm that taking possession does not forfeit the right to claim such interest. Notably, the Allahabad High Court supported a homebuyer over a substantial delay in receiving possession. Claims can rely on agreements, payment records, and RERA regulations, emphasizing the importance for buyers to understand their rights amid developer delays.

title: 14 Kazakh military personnel killed during naval exercise; five officers detained

In the aftermath, five defense officials were detained over alleged negligence regarding navigation protocols. Rescue teams bravely recovered three soldiers from the Caspian Sea. President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev has declared a national day of mourning to pay tribute to those who lost their lives.

title: Brij Bhushan sexual harassment case: Women wrestlers challenge acquittal

title: Asian Games: Joshna makes history with sixth medal; Anahat, Abhay storm into semis

Anahat Singh and Abhay Singh also advanced to the semifinals in women's and men's singles respectively. Each of these players is aiming for gold and potential Olympic qualification.

title: Is your 'paneer' really paneer? What FSSAI's latest proposal could change for you

The proposal affects both packaged goods and food businesses using substitutes. Stakeholders have been invited to provide feedback on these proposed regulations. Increased scrutiny of food safety and labelling practices has prompted this regulatory action to prevent consumer deception.

title: FAQs on Section 138 of NI Act: What happens once your cheque is dishonoured?
content: Bouncing a cheque can transform into a criminal offence under the Negotiable Instruments Act, creating legal repercussions. The cheque must be issued for a lawful debt and returned unpaid due to insufficient funds. After dishonour, the payee has 30 days to issue a notice, and the drawer has 15 days to respond. If not repaid, the payee can file a complaint within one month of the final notice.

title: EC-SIR row: Jantar Mantar entrance barricaded ahead of protests - video

title: How AI powered autonomous drones are reshaping aerial combat

This move aims to improve situational awareness and reduce risks to manned platforms in contested environments. The two new aircraft, General Atomics' YFQ-42A and Anduril's YFQ-44A, are currently undergoing testing. Manned-Unmanned Teaming is a key feature, allowing pilots to direct unmanned assets in combat.

There is a significant need for these interceptors among American and NATO forces in Europe.

This upcoming weapon is designed specifically to target hardened ground installations like bunkers and runways. A contract worth Rs 810.79 crore has been signed for 160 units of the advanced weapon system. The development emphasizes indigenous capabilities, showcasing the government's commitment to enhancing local defense manufacturing.

title: Colorado researchers grow saffron on solar panels, double yield and make $60,000

title: Toxic foam floods Kelavarapalli Dam: Farmers demand action
content:

The dam receives water from Karnataka during the monsoon. Farmers allege that sewage discharge from Karnataka is contributing to the persistent foam and pollution in the water. Despite repeated demands for action, the problem continues.

In this ground report, we speak to farmers and residents about the polluted water, its impact on their lives and livelihoods, and their demand for a lasting solution from the Water Resources Department and the Tamil Nadu Government.

title: Adani Group debuts at Kolkata’s Durga Puja celebrations
content: The maiden Durga Puja Adani Preview will comprise eight pujas across Kolkata and each of the eight selected pujas will receive a grant of ₹25 lakh from the Adani Group.

title: Alleged Myanmar-based extremists kill four Nagas in Manipur
content: The Working Committee of the Tangkhul Naga Long has blamed the Kuki National Army-Burma and Kuki elements backed by the Myanmar-based People’s Defence Force for the attack at Pilong village, the third such incident along the India-Myanmar border in Kamjong district

title: Kerala LoP Pinarayi Vijayan seeks removal of CEC Gyanesh Kumar, halt to SIR
content: In a post on ‘X’, Pinarayi says 'revelations' about objections raised by two Election Commissioners over decisions concerning voter registration, deletion of names and SIR raise 'grave questions' about functioning of Election Commission of India

title: Relief work picks up in Visakhapatnam; first flood warning on Nagavali and Vamsadhara
content: GVMC clears 102 of 112 fallen trees and finds 12 km of roads damaged; Home Minister Anitha asks officials to coordinate with Odisha on flood flows

title: Mamata AITC leader Ajit Maity arrested on extortion charges
content: Ajit Maity, who is associated with the Mamata Banerjee backed faction of Trinamool Congress, said that his arrest is for political reasons

title: Confident that Vijay will accept Rahul as Prime Ministerial candidate: T.N. Congress leader Manickam Tagore
content: In an interview with The Hindu, Tamil Nadu Congress Committee president B. Manickam Tagore exuded confidence that Mr. Vijay would make such an announcement ahead of the parliamentary election.

title: ‘Gem Granites’ Veeramani case: Police officer M.A. Yasmin, who first handled the case, also transferred
content: Ms. Yasmin, the ACP, Koyambedu, has been placed on ‘vacancy reserve’ on administrative grounds, according to sources. The police start probing charges that some political functionaries extorted money from the businessman

title: Western Ghats ESA: Keralam submits recommendations to Centre, seeks limiting area to 8,590 sq km
content: Keralam govt to introduce resolution on ESA issue when State Assembly convenes next, says Environment Minister Sunny Joseph

title: Revisit SIR exercise, CEC must resign: Naveen Patnaik on report of internal disquiet in poll panel
content: According to a newspaper report, Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi had formally objected at least 14 times over the past 10 months to decisions and orders of the CEC Gyanesh Kumar.

title: Udhayanidhi flays TVK-led government over alleged sexual assault of schoolgirl near Vandalur
content: He also accused the police of trying to cover up the crime and divert the issue by portraying it as a snakebite

title: Three killed, four injured in rain-related incidents in Krishna, NTR Districts
content: Woman electrocuted in Mopidevi mandal while two youths died after a car hit their bike due to poor visibility; police authorities set up pickets near the overflowing rivulets

title: Trump assassination attempt victim James Copenhaver dies at 76
content: copenhaver was injured when a gunman opened fire at his campaign rally . his cause of death was not disclosed . the 76-year-old died on friday at a hospital, his family says .

title: US returns 36 ancient Syrian artifacts worth over $5 million
content: the collection also includes 14 mosaics taken from a Roman villa in Syria . a third-century BCE mosaic section depicts the mythological wedding of Telete and Eros . ancient pieces of history that had traveled far from their original landscapes are now making the journey back home .

title: ‘Dead mindset cannot see vibrancy’: Amit Shah on Rahul’s ‘dead economy’ remark
content: amit Shah takes aim at Rahul Gandhi's 'dead economy' remark . he said some people were attempting to discredit India's GDP figures . the u.s. has raised its growth forecast for india from 6% to 7% .

title: ‘BrahMos made in UP giving Pakistan sleepless nights’: Amit Shah
content: u.s. home minister says the manufacturing of defence equipment in UP is a sign of the transformation taking place in the state and across India . he said investments in defence manufacturing are flowing into all six nodes of the Uttar Pradesh Defence Industrial Corridor .

title: Nationwide protests from Oct 2 if Gyanesh doesn't resign by Saturday: CJP's Dipke
content: dipke said the party would launch nationwide protests from Mumbai on Gandhi Jayanti . the announcement came a day after Dipke demanded Kumar's resignation . Dipke also criticised opposition parties for continuing to contest elections .

title: Ruckus in J&K assembly: BJP MLAs tear up statehood resolution moved by CM Omar
content: BJP rejects Omar's statehood resolution, opposes Article 370 debate . the resolution was fiercely opposed by the Bharatiya Janata Party . BJP accuses the ruling party of being anti-national .

title: SIR row: Plea in SC seeks prosecution of CEC Gyanesh Kumar, SIT inquiry
content: plea seeks inquiry into alleged deletion of 13 crore voters from electoral rolls . alleged unilateral decisions taken in connection with electoral roll revision exercise . petitioner has also sought a special Investigation Team inquiry into the alleged dna deletion . also seeks prosecution of chief election commissioner, deputy election commissioner maneesh Garg .

title: ‘Nothing to do with SIR row’: EC on postponement of CEC's UP outreach events
content: the election commission clarifies that the postponement of chief election commissioner's youth outreach events in Uttar Pradesh had nothing to do with the ongoing row over alleged internal differences in the poll body . a number of factors were necessiated due to logistical factors such as availability of venues, schedules of higher authorities and natural factors .
